plan.notes: Source: official 'Computer Science - Cybersecurity Concentration BS Four-Year Plan' PDF, University of Delaware 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog, https://catalog.udel.edu/mime/media/94/7381 (PDF created 2025-06-17 for the 2025-2026 catalog; downloaded 2026-09-30). True program name per catalog.udel.edu: 'Computer Science - Cybersecurity Concentration (BS)', College of Engineering, Dept. of Computer and Information Sciences. IMPORTANT CREDENTIAL HONESTY: this is the Cybersecurity Concentration BS - a separate credential with its own official four-year plan. The plain (no-concentration) BS Computer Science is BLOCKED: its catalog requirement list publishes no official term-by-term sequence (documented in the blocked log). Transcription method: all 8 semesters transcribed 1:1 from the official PDF (verified against 150-dpi page renders of the actual table; the page-2 image confirmed the correct fall/spring column pairing, including a blank Fall cell in Fourth Year row 5). Choice slots (choice:true) represent official either/or rows with descriptive placeholder codes. No courses invented. Credit accounting: semester totals match the PDF exactly (15/15/16/16/15/15/16/16 = 124). Per-slot credits are NOT published in the PDF for variable slots; recorded so each semester reconciles to its published total: EGGG 101 = 2 cr; MATH 241 = 4 cr; science slots = 4+4 (the program page requires an 8-credit lab-science sequence); CISC Elective = 3 cr (program page: 3-4 credits of 300-level+ CISC); Free Elective (5/6) = 4 cr and Free Elective (6/6) = 1 cr (free electives are variable-credit). Caveats: (1) The official plan PDF lists 'CISC 465 - Introduction to Cybersecurity' in BOTH Spring Year 3 and Spring Year 4; the second occurrence is coded CISC 465-2 (see its slot note) per the unique-code rule. The catalog program page lists the concentration's cybersecurity requirement as CPEG 465 - Introduction to Cybersecurity (3 cr) - the Y3-spring placement is the logical one (it precedes CISC 464 and the advanced cybersecurity electives); the Y4-spring duplicate is almost certainly a typo in the official PDF, transcribed faithfully rather than 'corrected'. (2) Prerequisite chains are not published in the four-year plan PDF; per the official-sources-only rule none were inferred, so all prereq arrays are empty. (3) The ENGL 312/ENGL 410 slot satisfies Breadth Requirement 5/5; CISC 355, ENGL 312 and ENGL 410 count as upper-level breadth per the program page. (4) Free Elective (1/6) carries the official note 'MATH 242 - Analytic Geometry and Calculus B recommended'. (5) Program page consulted for the concentration requirement list, restricted-elective list, and credit rules: catalog.udel.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=90&poid=78393 (2024-2025 archived edition; the four-year plan itself is the 2025-2026 edition).
